name: first-message
opens_with: Fresh boot in the opening empty state; the user sends their first message and the agent replies
notes: The 2026-10-09 visual audit complaint 2: the user reported the 'opening screen never transitions' after sending a message. The corpus env sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, so with iter-703's live credentials the auth inventory must show a CONFIGURED session by the time the first reply lands — never the unconfigured '/login to add provider' fallback block. The transcript must carry the user's message; the mock agent's reply must be on screen. Pairs with the auth_status unit tests (matrix refresh, provider inference) and the terminal-clear scenario. Reshaped by the 2026-10-09 N-2 fix: the mock submit path now commits the user message to the transcript exactly like the live paths (pre-fix it silently dropped it and showed only the restored composer text), so the golden carries the user row + the reply and the assert counts both. Pairs with user-message-commits, which gates the no-agent-event window.
